### Migration plan

Here is a **safe** order of operations:

1. Back up the bucket
2. Run the migration in a *dry run*
3. Swap the binding

- Docs: [Workers docs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/)

```bash
wrangler r2 object get mail/backup.tar --file ./backup.tar
```

| Step | Risk |
| --- | --- |
| Backup | Low |
| Swap | **High** |
